identity.real_world_identity_notes: Customer GT3 racing car on the 991.2 generation 911, with a four-litre water-cooled flat six. Porsche specifies a sequential six-speed constant-mesh gearbox with an electronic shift actuator, changed by steering-wheel paddles.

wheel_rim.notes: Porsche's exact 2019 material establishes a multi-function CFRP racing wheel with paddles but does not establish its rim category.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: clutch-free move-off, six paddle-selected gears, and automatic cut and blip.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip. This matches every other curated paddle-shift GT3 car.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.porsche-911-gt3-r.20260813t161631591z-4b6f6c96 by Jason Kinslow.

overrides.condition: AMS2 1.6.9.91 models a D-shaped rim for the 2019 911 GT3 R.

confidence.basis: Direct cockpit inspection during the guided drive.
Simulator behavior was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world six-speed sequential paddle transmission is established by a registered source.

notes: Observed live in ACC 21257365 via guided verification observation acc.porsche-911-ii-gt3-r-2019.20260823t012717503z-8d8b3498 by Jason Kinslow.

confidence.basis: Direct cockpit inspection during the ACC contribution drive.

claims.basis: Porsche establishes a multi-function CFRP racing wheel with paddles for the exact 2019 car, but does not specify whether its graspable rim is D-shaped or GT/Formula.
The registered source establishes the real-world identity and transmission, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
The manufacturer specifies a sequential six-speed constant-mesh gearbox with an electronic shift actuator and paddle control; the live drive confirmed six paddle gears and clutch-free move-off.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.
Telemetry name `Porsche 911 II GT3 R 2019`, internal id `porsche_991ii_gt3_r`, and class `GT3` identify the 991.2 car and exclude ACC's earlier 2018 and later 992 variants.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.

deviations.basis: Whether the car needs a throttle lift on upshifts is not established. A guided drive settles it, by holding the throttle through an upshift and seeing whether the gear engages.
